(1) the user interface is very important for the usability of a hypertext system; (2) the user interface of the query module of CONCORDE supports the user to create and modify queries in an easy way; (3) the query module of a hypertext is able to exploit the structure of the system.
the user interface is a graphical query interface that enables the user to exploit the hypertext structures for querying.
the graphical structure-oriented search facility is useful for the users of the hypertext systems and that it is easy and fast to use for them.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new way of using the hypertext structures for retrieval purposes.
a hypertext system which supports the user in creating and browsing a hypertext database.
the development of a hypertext system that is easy to use and provides a rich query language for searching the hypertext structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have created a query facility for a hypertext system which enables users to search the structure of hypertext documents and which is very user-friendly.
the user interface for querying the hypertext is very intuitive and easy to use.
hypertext is a powerful and useful tool, but not a panacea.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a hypertext system can be used as an efficient tool for the creation of a query system.
we have developed a graphical query interface for a hypertext database.

we have created a hypertext system which supports both content-oriented and structure-oriented retrieval and which has a user interface for the structure-oriented retrieval that is as easy to use as for the content-oriented one.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a graphical user interface is a powerful means to support the user in formulating complex queries in hypertexts.
a graphical query interface for a hypertext system can be designed in a way that it is easy to learn, easy to use, and easy to maintain.
hypertext structures can be used for query formulation in a very natural and intuitive way.
